title.rendered: 2018-19 Kinder Registration Packets are available in the Archer Glen office

content.rendered:
The 2018-2019 Kindergarten Registration Packets are available in the front office at Archer Glen. We are now accepting Kindergarten registration information for your child. Students must turn 5 years old by September 1, 2018 to enter Kindergarten in the fall. Please call the Archer Glen office at 503.825. 5100, if you have questions. 

If you have picked up a Kindergarten packet, please turn it in to the office at your earliest convenience.
